$comment: Coordinator operations of the tasks domain; the rules are in ops.schema.json $comment and contracts/README.md.

project_detail.description: Read a project definition and revision independently of resource statistics; requires projectId

project_resources.description: Read prepared project resource figures/version and current progress; requires projectId

project_resource_items.description: Read a bounded prepared tools/costs/prices window with an epoch-bound cursor or surviving anchor; requires projectId

project_context.description: A project's definition, settings and context (projectId)

project_list.description: Projects you can reach with their codes

project_readiness.description: Check a project per environment host: remote reachable, checkout, setup script, bound account login; read results with execution_status

question_answer.description: Answers a project question, or any other question by id.

question_ask.description: Ask a project question (projectId, requestId, text); read its answer with question_history

question_history.description: Questions asked in a project (projectId) with their answers

questions_answer.description: Answer a question (questionId, answer, optional artifactIds)

project_view.description: One project's Overview in one read (docs/design-system/pages/projects.md): its open questions and the Lab decisions waiting for you (finished experiments without a decision, each variant with its score, trials, failures, median time and cost), tasks in flight, the pipelines it uses grouped by job (catalogue methods in use or scoped to it and the pipelines its Lab experiments ran, each with its best result on the project's sample), the latest results and conversations, and delivery (pull requests in flight, merged count, the last merge). Counted on the server.

project_pipeline_view.description: One pipeline as a project uses it, in one read (the pipeline page, docs/design-system/pages/projects.md): what it does (description, input, output), its steps as the plain-text outline, its catalogue method and whether it is the one in use, the comparison on the project's sample (every variant of the pipelines its experiments ran for the same job, best first, 90 days) and the project's experiments that ran it, newest first.

projects_view.description: The Projects screen in one read: each visible project's open questions, sessions working and tasks in flight (the catalogue, every project), and the summary over the focus (projectIds or excludeProjectIds, '-' is work outside projects): the open questions waiting for you (the first 3 and how many), each project's sessions working and tasks in flight, and the pull requests in flight. Counted on the server.

questions_list.description: Questions by project, task, state or kind

questions_withdraw.description: Owner or full access: withdraw open questions that no longer need anyone (ids up to 1000, reason); one audit row each; skipped lists ids not open

task_cancel.description: Cancel a task (taskId): no further work starts and running work is asked to stop

entity_resolve.description: Case-insensitive; unknown and forbidden codes both answer 404.

entity_resolve_many.description: Resolve every entity code in a text to its kind and id

entity_card.description: A short card of one entity: code (T-FLT-42, Q-…, C-…, old codes too) or kind (task, question, conversation, execution, result, experiment, project, host, agent, pipeline, pull_request as owner/repo#n, release as its tag) with id. Returns its state, title, project, harness, last time, 1-4 facts, the app path and an outside url; unknown and forbidden are both 404

project_code_set.description: 2 to 5 characters, a letter first, not hex-only, no I or O, never used before. The project's tasks, questions and conversations get new codes; old codes stay aliases.

task_create.description: held: the task waits for task_release (always for an agent).

task_derived_check.description: Check that stored task states match the states derived from their executions

task_get.description: A task (taskId) with its executions, questions and results

task_hold.description: Hold a task (taskId): no new work starts until task_release

task_list.description: Tasks, optionally of one project or state

task_page.description: A page of tasks by filter, group and sort, with group counts, paged with after and limit

task_request_acceptance.description: No artifactIds: the task's stored originals.

task_take.description: Take a task (taskId) onto your own subscription

task_update.description: action pause, resume, cancel or fail; the other fields replace the stored value when present.

problems_list.description: Problems (anomalies with a bot owner), newest first; open by default.

problem_get.description: One problem by id, code (P-12) or open cause.

problem_update.description: The owner bot (or the owner) sets a problem's phase, note or linked work, or closes it as fixed or as a duplicate of another problem.

problem_escalate.description: The owner bot asks the owner one question about a problem: kind only-you (a key, account, money, vendor act), product (no requirement picks between outcomes) or authority (irreversible, deletes data, overrides the owner's setting). Never to ask whether to look.

ResourcePackedToolKey.$comment: tp1. plus base64url of one complete zlib stream containing {schemaVersion:1,key:ResourceToolKey}; a position, never authority.

ResourceToolKey.$comment: Preserve full admitted native tool names/connections, including values longer than 200 characters; positions remain subject to the HTTP body bound.

EntityCode.$comment: A human code (D17) and the entity it names; superseded: an alias of currentCode (a moved entity or a renamed project).

code.$comment: A D17 code (T-, Q-, C-; old codes too), case-insensitive.

id.$comment: The entity id: a UUID, a host, project, agent or pipeline id, owner/repo#number for a pull request, a release tag (v1.2.3, ui-1.2.2-v1.2.3).

EntityCardRequest.$comment: A code, or a kind with its id. Unknown and forbidden both answer 404.

EntityFactType.$comment: How a fact's value is formatted (formats.md): time is RFC 3339, count and bytes are integers, duration is seconds.

code.$comment: The current human code: T-FLT-42, #643 for a pull request, the tag for a release; null when the kind has none.

uuid.$comment: The UUID to copy (OR-38: never shown); null for kinds named by a human id.

state.$comment: The kind's own state (registry family: task, question, session, execution, artifact, experiment, host, delivery).

atLabel.$comment: What at is: changed, asked, active, started, stored, seen, since.

facts.$comment: One to four kind-specific facts, in display order.

url.$comment: Its page outside Fleet (a pull request on GitHub).

EntityCardReply.$comment: A card summary of one entity for an entity reference: the same read for people (the card) and agents (MCP tool).

EntityResolveRequest.$comment: Case-insensitive; unknown and forbidden codes both answer 404.

EntityResolveManyReply.$comment: Every known code in the text, in order of first appearance; unknown and forbidden codes are left out.

ProjectCodeSetRequest.$comment: 2 to 5 characters, a letter first, not hex-only, no I or O, never used before. The project's tasks, questions and conversations get new codes; old codes stay aliases.

ProjectContextReply.$comment: The project's context (projectContext): settings, roles, connections, rules, and optional resource summary.

items.$comment: A project's context (projectContext): settings, roles, connections, rules; name, code and the optional description and domain at the top.

ProjectQuestion.$comment: A project question to the operator; state waiting or answered.

executionId.$comment: The readiness check run; null when the host could not run one (problem).

ProjectReadinessHost.$comment: A host's readiness for the project.

QuestionAnswerReply.$comment: A project question (ProjectQuestion), or the answered question row for any other question.

QuestionAnswerRequest.$comment: Answers a project question, or any other question by id.

QuestionRow.$comment: One question row (questionCols in go/coordinator/tasks.go); artifactIds and cause only when set.

QuestionsWithdrawRequest.$comment: Owner or full access: withdraws open questions that no longer need anyone; one setting-change audit row per question.

projectIds.$comment: The summary's focus: only these projects ('-': work outside projects).

excludeProjectIds.$comment: The summary leaves these projects out ('-': work outside projects).

choices.$comment: The experiment's variants as the leaderboard ranks them, best first.

ProjectDecision.$comment: A finished Lab experiment of the project that waits for a decision.

capability.$comment: The job: the catalogue capability, else the Lab use case id.

useCaseId.$comment: The Lab use case its experiments ran (Compare).

inUse.$comment: The method in use for the project; null: not chosen yet.

pipelines.$comment: The method in use first, then by best score.

experiments.$comment: The project's experiments that ran these pipelines (90 days).

reads.$comment: The definition's input: what it reads.

returns.$comment: The definition's output: what it returns.

method.$comment: The catalogue method that runs it.

inUse.$comment: Its method is the one in use for the project.

useCaseId.$comment: The Lab use case of its comparison.

ranking.$comment: Every variant of the project's experiments on the same use case, best first; this pipeline's rows carry its pipelineId.

experiments.$comment: The project's experiments that ran it, newest first.

methodId.$comment: The catalogue method that runs it, when one does.

best.$comment: Its best variant on the project's sample (the project's experiments, 90 days); absent without trials.

trials.$comment: Its Lab trials in the project, 90 days.

description.$comment: The project's one-line description (settings.description); absent when none.

domain.$comment: The host name the project serves (settings.domain), such as revilio.com; absent when none.

waiting.$comment: The first 3 open questions, oldest first.

inWork.$comment: The first 5 tasks in flight, recently changed first.

pm.$comment: The project's PM conversation (its profile is the project's pm role), newest; absent when it has none yet.

catalogue.$comment: Every visible project with open questions, sessions working or tasks in flight; a project with none is absent.

waiting.$comment: The first 3 open questions in the focus, oldest first.

lines.$comment: The focus's projects with sessions working or tasks in flight (questions is 0 here); projectId null: work outside projects.

delivery.$comment: Pull requests in flight in the focus (open, in CI, failed, in the merge queue, releasing, installing).

inFlight.$comment: tasks in the Running system view's states

projectIds.$comment: keep rows of these projects only (the app passes the person's focus, OR-34); '-' is no project

excludeProjectIds.$comment: leave out rows of these projects (the app passes the person's ignored projects while the view names no project, OR-34); '-' is no project (an empty id or null is a 400); applied after projectIds, so a project in both is left out. Agents see every project unless they pass it.

TaskCreateRequest.$comment: held: the task waits for task_release (always for an agent).

acceptedArtifactIds.$comment: Accepted collection in selection order. For a completed accepted task, latestResult is its first visible stored selection, or null when none is available; unaccepted work retains publication-version ordering.

heldBy.$comment: Actor who held the task (a person's email or execution:<id>), while it is held; absent when unknown or not held.

heldByName.$comment: Display name of heldBy at the time of the hold.

completionReportMissing.$comment: True when a confirmed successful agent run lacks a completion report and the task has no pending continuation or valid completion evidence. Informational only.

history.$comment: Task history: the task's conversations, oldest first.

TaskDetail.$comment: A task with its progress, cost, scoped resources, executions, dependencies and questions (taskGet).

role.$comment: the profile role (pm, worker, reviewer, ...) else the profile id; empty for none

createdTask.$comment: the conversation that created the task

TaskConversation.$comment: A conversation of a task's history (docs/designs/fleet-conversations.md#entities): it created the task, runs on it, or is a bot's conversation for subject task:<id>.

heldBy.$comment: Actor who held the task (a person's email or execution:<id>), while it is held; absent when unknown or not held.

heldByName.$comment: Display name of heldBy at the time of the hold.

sort.$comment: order inside a group: changed or created, - before it is descending; default -changed (recently changed first)

TaskProgress.$comment: executions: the count; byState: counts by execution state.

TaskRequestAcceptanceRequest.$comment: No artifactIds: the task's stored originals.

TaskUpdateRequest.$comment: action pause, resume, cancel or fail; the other fields replace the stored value when present.

work.$comment: a task code or pull request URL

conversationId.$comment: the owner bot's conversation for this problem (subject problem:<id>), when it exists

before.$comment: the code of the last row of the previous page

cause.$comment: the open problem of this cause

duplicateOf.$comment: with close duplicate: the other problem's id or code

text.$comment: the diagnosis in one line, what was tried, what only the owner can give and the recommendation
